dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: You there, Leaf Hat. I have a question.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: The Pari find it challenging enough to protect the Vourukasha Oasis. How have you managed to protect a domain as vast as the rainforest for hundreds of years?

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: You are not a Nara... You are a bird! Red and warm and small! Arasaka can make you something to eat!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: A... bird? No, I am a Pari. We live in the Vourukasha Oasis.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: The Vourukasha Oasis? Like Vanarana... but for a bird?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Vana... rana? Something tells me this conversation is going nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Little red bird is a good bird! Good birds can come to Vanarana. Arasaka will make you delicious food.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: We can practice Ararakalari together, and find lots and lots of "tracer"!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: (Have I been stuck at the Oasis for too long? It's like I can't understand the language of the outside world anymore... Whatever he said sounded impressive, though.)
